note: v6 lane B, Zen mode (tools/zen-mode-notes.md; levels for the relaxed mode, open from the start). worlds: in order, bottom of the Zen map to top; each {k, name, lore (the banner and the realm card), era (the era its levels carry: a land world its land’s, castleRealms + land; a world of its own, 100 + k), then either land: k (its levels are levels.json’s with that land, its side quests gallery.json’s, its sheets map/layout.json’s, all as tools/land.js installed them) or map.sheets: [{from: a sheet of map/layout.json whose painting, road and spots it reuses (any sheet, a land’s too), mirror, fade, tint (a CSS filter over the image), levels: [first, last] (this world’s level numbers), spots (which of the sheet’s level spots carry them, road order; default the first ones), eggsAt (“quests”: the two eggs on the sheet’s painted side-quest spur tips) and eggKinds}] (this world’s level numbers on that sheet’s spots, in road order)}] with its levels here (ids z<k>-<n>, made by tools/zen-world.js)}. Every world’s first level is open from the start; inside a world they open one by one. A new world is one more entry (tools/land-runbook.md, Zen).

worlds.name: Picture Garden
worlds.lore: A quiet garden at the start of the road: fruit, sweets, animals and old paintings, each one dug out a block at a time.

map.note: Fix pass (Peter): Kitten Forest’s two sheets (no new image bytes), in a different turn and tint from World 2 so the join never shows one sheet twice: B mirrored, A mirrored, B, A mirrored, B (World 2 starts on A). 36 levels: 8 then 7 a sheet (spot 5 skipped, which leaves no wider gap than a sheet join). Eggs at the painted side-quest spurs’ tips.

worlds.name: Kitten Forest
worlds.lore: Past the Gallery the road runs on into a lantern-lit wood of giant toadstools, where kittens nap, play and make mischief in every glade.
